correctness.rationale: For right simplex conv(0,a_i e_i) in R^n, gnomonic section through tangent cone at a_i e_i yields spherical Jacobian (1+|z|²)^(-n/2). Changing z_j=a_j t_j/a_i gives the stated positive integral with common prefactor prod a_j over standard Δ_{n-1}. The origin angle is the spherical positive orthant; nonzero vertex cones are proper subsets of similarly measured sign orthants. Swapping i and j in paired simplex integrals changes denominators by (a_i²-a_j²)(1-t²); t<1 a.e., proving complete strict ordering by reverse leg length. The denominator for every t is <diam(S)^2 in positive measure, giving Ω_i>n μ. With a1=L>q=max b_j, diam=sqrt(L²+q²), and the uniform Dirichlet-simplex moment E[t_j²]=2/[n(n+1)], the cone integral gives Ωmin=B/((n-1)!L^(n-1))*(1-B2/((n+1)L²)+O(L^-4)); division by nμ gives the claimed coefficient n q²/2-B2/(n+1)>0. Independently verified three n=2 formulas against right-triangle angles and two n=3 quadratures with L=40,80 giving rescaled ratio 4.75049,4.75012 vs target 4.75; dimension-uniform proof is analytic.
residual_risks: Finite independent tests do not certify any unrestricted theorem; analytical argument and published structural lemmas carry generality.
